sentences.text:
Author: D. Dash
Bench: D. Dash
 Ablapl No.962 Of 2021
 03. 08.03.2021: The matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement
 (virtual/physical) mode.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned  counsel for the State.

The Petitioner having been implicated in connection  with Dharmasala P.S. Case No.29 of 2021 corresponding to  C.T. Case No.103 of 2021 on the file of learned J.M.F.C.,
 Chandikhole for alleged commission of offence under  section-420/272/273 of the IPC read with section-56 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, has filed this application  under section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in the event of  his arrest in the said case.
Considering the submissions made and on going  through the materials on record; I don't find it to be a fit case  for entertaining this application for grant of anticipatory bail  to the Petitioner.

It is, however, observed that when the  occasion would so arise for the learned court in seisin of the  case to consider the matter relating to grant of regular bail to  the Petitioner, the same shall be made on its own merit  without being prejudiced by this order and disposed of early  in accordance with law.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.

..........................
 D. Dash, J.
Narayan ABLAPL/962/2021 on 8 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41278356/
